input._note: Verbatim echo of the request, never inferred and never back-filled. THIS RUN WAS INVOKED WITH AN EXPLICIT MECHANISM HYPOTHESIS, which is the whole reason the pair of IRAK4 dossiers exists: the same accession under a different mechanism_hypothesis is a DIFFERENT ANSWER, and any cache, dedup or comparison downstream must key on (input.uniprot_accession, input.mechanism_hypothesis, input.as_of_date). tractability._primary: TWO DIFFERENT KINDS OF NUMBER. pocket_volume_a3.primary_d1_6_a3 is an ABSOLUTE physical quantity and may be compared across structures, but carries no verdict: the AUC 1.000 separation is RETRACTED (rule 4a) and volume fails the clustering-sensitivity test worse than druggability did. Do not compare it to 210 or 240 A^3. pocket_druggability is a WITHIN-STRUCTURE quantity by construction; its reportable form is site_pocket_rank.

pocket_volume_a3._primary_note: primary_d1_6_a3 = 682.5 A^3 is the ligand-anchored site pocket of the HOLO entry 6EGE at D=1.6 ONLY (site_pocket_selected_by = ligand_site_jaccard, Jaccard 0.63 against the DL1 contact set). min/max pool three structures AND both clustering values, which is legitimate for volume because volume is absolute — 6EGE 682.5 / 2OIB 590.3 / 2O8Y 463.6 at D=1.6, and 922.1 / 1398.8 / 612.2 at D=2.4. The 836 A^3 swing is mostly the clustering knob, not the biology: at D=2.4 2OIB exceeds 1000 A^3 and the site has merged with neighbouring cavities. THE 210/240 A^3 GUIDE IS WITHDRAWN AND MAY NOT BE REVIVED (rule 4a). Report the volume; do not classify with it.

pocket_druggability._comparability: WITHIN ONE STRUCTURE, ACROSS THE D SWEEP — the legitimate form. Both values are 6EGE's ligand-anchored site pocket: 0.413 at D=1.6 and 0.544 at D=2.4. This is NOT pooled across structures. Pooling would have manufactured a meaningless range and this ensemble shows why: the SAME site in 2O8Y scores 0.791 at D=1.6 and 0.001 at D=2.4, a 791-fold move produced entirely by the clustering parameter changing the pocket population that the score's dominant descriptor is min-max normalised against (fpocket pocket.c:736-756). That 0.791 -> 0.001 is an independent in-run reproduction of the figure rule 4 quotes for IRAK4 2O8Y.
pocket_druggability._provenance: shipped fpocket 4.2.3: a 3-descriptor logistic regression fitted on 21 positive pockets against 292 others. A weak prior, not a probability. Its dominant term mean_loc_hyd_dens_norm is min-max normalised over the CURRENT STRUCTURE'S OWN pocket list, so the score answers 'how does this pocket rank against the others in this file', never 'how druggable is this pocket'.
pocket_druggability._false_negative_rate: REPORTED, NEVER LOAD-BEARING, NEVER COMPARED ACROSS STRUCTURES. Named cases rather than a percentage: the 41% figure's denominator is under audit. This run adds one of its own — 6EGE is a 1.40 A holo crystal with a 379 Da drug-like amide physically bound, and its own ligand-anchored site pocket scores 0.413 and ranks 2 of 11. A target with 11,416 compounds and 0.022 nM chemistry does not score like a certainty on this number, which is the point.
pocket_druggability._do_not_max: max-over-pockets measures pocket count. site_pocket_selected_by = max_druggability_no_ligand_site must never produce a reportable value. It did not fire here — all six mode-1 measurements were anchored, four by ligand_site_jaccard and two by site_signature_overlap. It DID fire on the companion oligomer_destabilisation run, and see that dossier for what it produced.

site_pocket_rank._note: THE REPORTABLE FORM OF DRUGGABILITY. The claim is 'rank 2 of 11 in 6EGE at D=1.6, PRANK rank 1'. fpocket rank and PRANK rank are two within-structure orderings on the same footing; here they DISAGREE and the disagreement is reported as one — PRANK promotes the ligand-anchored site to rank 1 in all three structures and at both clustering values (6 of 6), while fpocket's own ordering puts it 2nd, 5th, 4th, 15th, 4th and 23rd. That is the n=70 pattern (promotes 79%, demotes 1%) reproducing on this target.

ensemble_consensus_fraction._note: Published criterion: ~70% of structures showing a strong hot spot, ~50% meeting all criteria. One good conformer out of five is a negative result. Kept as an anti-cherry-picking control, NOT read as a tractability signal (AUC 0.560, ranks MYC top).
ensemble_consensus_fraction.source: pocket_scan Modal run 2026-08-15: ensemble.n_structures 3 (6EGE, 2OIB, 2O8Y) x D in {1.6, 2.4} = 6 measurements. The site pocket was located in 6 of 6. The tool emits no consensus fraction and 'strong hot spot' has no threshold we are willing to set, so the fraction is null rather than invented — see not_found.

tractability.site_hypothesis_basis: holo ligand site — 6EGE:DL1, auto-derived by pocket_scan as that entry's drug-like ligand (not supplied by hand). Confirmed per structure: the two holo measurements were selected by ligand_site_jaccard (0.63 at D=1.6, 0.531 at D=2.4); the four apo measurements fell back to site_signature_overlap, which is a residue-number match and is weaker. Neither entry is a homo-oligomer at the site (chain A scored alone), so the signature is not ambiguous by symmetry.
tractability.site_centroid_to_ligand_note: The volumes above are fpocket's. The mdpocket cross-check used site_from_ligand, which is the ligand site by construction and carries no distance of its own. The 3.31 A recorded here is rule 4b's off-site check on the OTHER definition: site_from_density — the largest cavity open in all three structures, found without reference to any ligand — sits 3.31 A from the transferred 6EGE:DL1 centroid, inside the PROPOSED (not calibrated) 4 A threshold, and pocket_scan raised no off_site_warning. The two independent site definitions agree, which is the check passing. It is closer to the threshold than JAK1's 1.86 A and much closer than TNF-alpha's 29.57 A failure.
tractability._annotated_binding_site_overlap_basis: 10 of the 15 residues UniProt annotates as Binding site on Q9NWZ3 (192-200, 213, 313-316, 329) fall in the 6EGE D=1.6 site-pocket lining: 192, 193, 194, 195, 200, 213, 313, 315, 316, 329. The five misses are 196-199, 314 and — separately — the catalytic Active site 311, which lines the cleft but did not fall in the alpha-sphere set. The computed pocket and the curated ATP site are the same site. Source: uniprot_v.features WHERE accession='Q9NWZ3' against structures.6EGE.by_clustering.1.6.site_pocket.residues.

cryptic_evidence._note: The apo census the cryptic call rests on. Vajda 2018: cryptic only if the site is absent in all, or nearly all, unbound structures.
cryptic_evidence.basis: Measured, not inferred from tier. Both apo entries were superposed on the holo 6EGE and both passed the superposition gate, which I read myself rather than trusting the cryptic_status label: 2OIB core C-alpha RMSD 0.919 A over 256 fitted C-alpha (7 excluded, 263 equivalent), 2O8Y 1.066 A over 256 fitted (4 excluded, 260 equivalent), both far inside the 5.0 A ceiling and far above the 20-C-alpha floor. Site-residue C-alpha RMSD is 0.96 A (2OIB) and 1.26 A (2O8Y), both below the CryptoBench 2.0 A cut. Max backbone C-alpha displacement at the site is 1.83 A (2OIB) and 2.29 A (2O8Y) — the same order as TNF-alpha's ~1.6 A non-cryptic case and an order below KRAS's ~8.8 A collapse. The site pocket was detected in both apo entries at both clustering values (4 of 4 apo measurements), so it is present, not absent. The self-control clash test against the holo structure itself returned 0 contact pairs, so the superposition and ligand placement are not silently broken.
cryptic_evidence.definition: Vajda et al. 2018 stringent form — cryptic only if the pocket is absent in all or nearly all unbound structures — operationalised by CryptoBench as pocket-residue RMSD > 2 A between apo and holo. IRAK4's ATP site fails both criteria in the direction of NOT cryptic.
cryptic_evidence.source: pocket_scan cryptic stage (cryptic_analysis.py, gemmi + numpy), holo 6EGE:DL1 against apo 2OIB and 2O8Y, 2026-08-15

cryptic_potency_prior._note: Mechanism is a prior on achievable potency. Loop-motion sites: 25 of 27 reached nanomolar. Side-chain sites: all measured ones were low-micromolar at best.
cryptic_potency_prior.basis: Not applicable rather than unmeasured: the site is pre-formed in both apo entries, so neither the loop-motion nor the side-chain-occlusion prior bears on it. pocket_scan returned expected_ceiling 'unknown' for the same reason. The observed ceiling is empirical, not prior — 0.022 nM.

pocket_vs_interface._note: Measured, not assumed. Requires a complex structure containing the partner.
pocket_vs_interface._why: The interface stage was deliberately not run for this mechanism and this is not a gap. The hypothesis is orthosteric ATP-competitive inhibition of the catalytic cleft; the thing being blocked is a nucleotide, not a protein partner, so there is no partner interface for the pocket to overlap. IRAK4 does have a deposited protein-partner complex — 3MOP — but it contains the DEATH DOMAIN (residues 4-106) and no part of the kinase domain, so classifying this pocket against that interface would compare two structures that share no residue. The companion oligomer_destabilisation dossier is where that interface is measured.

tractability.clash_attribution: At a 2.0 A cutoff the transferred DL1 has ZERO clashing atoms against apo 2OIB (minimum approach 2.35 A) and 3 backbone contacts against apo 2O8Y (minimum 1.42 A), with zero side-chain and zero displaced-chain contacts in both. The self-control against the holo structure itself is 0 pairs at 2.72 A minimum, so the superposition is sound. Rule 5: classification is on C-alpha displacement (1.83 / 2.29 A = small), NOT on clash composition — keying on the three backbone contacts in 2O8Y would invert the answer, which is the KRAS lesson. Both readings agree here anyway: the site is open in the unbound state.
tractability.caveat: Three things a reader should discount this by. (1) The computed axis is REPORTED but is not carrying the verdict — verdict_basis is retrieved_precedent. Volume carries no verdict after rule 4a's retraction and druggability is a within-structure rank that may never carry one, so on the computed axis alone this dossier would say 'a pre-formed, ligand-confirmed cleft of 682.5 A^3' and stop there. (2) Geometric pocket scoring is blind to cryptic pockets in general; that blindness does not bite here because a holo structure exists and the apo census was run, but it would bite on any site of this protein that is not the ATP cleft. (3) Chain selection was ASSERTED, not defaulted: chain A only, at every entry. That is the correct unit for an intrachain ATP site and it is a different assertion from the one the companion dossier makes; the two runs share zero residues.

affinity._why_null: Rule 13: there is no affinity predictor in this deployment, so rule 12's mandatory positive control is unsatisfiable rather than skipped. The correct response to an unsatisfiable control is a null with a stated reason, never a prediction reported without one. Note what was available and deliberately not used: IRAK4 has an excellent control compound to hand (CHEMBL4443947, IC50 0.022 nM in a characterised MBP-substrate kinase assay). Having the control and no predictor is still no prediction.

checks_run: 1. Does the actives count collapse to one assay? GROUP BY assay_description with a window-function share over all 32,838 activities. Largest single assay is an AlphaScreen biochemical assay at 3,168 rows = 9.6%; the next four are 8.8%, 6.7%, 5.7%, 5.0%. Nothing approaches rule 6's ~30% concentration threshold. CHECK RUN, NOTHING FOUND.

1b. Is the dominant assay measuring a different protein? The 8.8% entry is 'IRAK4 Monocyte TNFalpha Cell Based Assay: Cryopreserved', 2,895 rows — the mirror image of the TNF-alpha case in rule 6, where the SAME assay appears under P01375 as assay_id 2591534 with 2,901 rows and inflates TNF's precedent. Here it is correctly attributed: IRAK4 is the measured protein and TNF-alpha is the readout. FOUND, AND IT FAVOURS THIS TARGET rather than damaging it — which is why it is recorded.

2. Is the best potency from a characterised assay? Yes. 0.022 nM is IC50, standard_relation '=', confidence_score 9, from 'Binding affinity to human IRK4 using myelin basic protein as substrate' — a named substrate and a named enzyme, not MYC's 'Inhibition of c-MYC (unknown origin)'. The next eleven values down to 0.1 nM are likewise whole-blood or DELFIA enzymatic assays with descriptions. CHECK RUN, NOTHING FOUND.

2c. Are approved-drug rows in the bioactivity table being read as precedent? Not applicable in the damaging direction: there are no max_phase 4 rows to mistake. Zero approved drugs of any modality exist on this accession. CHECK RUN, NOTHING FOUND.

6. Is the accession mapping real, and are hits inherited? chembl_v.target_proteins returns FOUR targets for Q9NWZ3, not one: tid 19639 CHEMBL3778 'SINGLE PROTEIN' with n_target_components = 1, and three PROTEIN-PROTEIN INTERACTION targets with n_target_components = 2 — CHEMBL4523710 cereblon/IRAK4, CHEMBL4523723 XIAP/IRAK4, CHEMBL4523742 VHL/IRAK4. Those are DEGRADER TERNARY-COMPLEX targets. FOUND: 369 of the 32,838 activities (1.1%), across 169 distinct compounds, are inherited from an n_target_components > 1 target and are not direct IRAK4 binding measurements. Small, but it is the channel the DC50 numbers arrive through.

8. Is a look-alike being counted, and is a degrader's DC50 being read as affinity? FOUND, AND IT IS THE SHARPEST RESULT OF THE SWEEP. KT-474 (CHEMBL5569030) is a clinical IRAK4 agent at max_phase 1 and its headline numbers are DC50 0.46, 1.5 and 2.0 nM — all 'CRBN-mediated IRAK4 degradation' in PBMC and OCI-Ly10 cells, all with pchembl_value NULL. Its only binding measurement is IC50 = 41 nM (pChEMBL 7.39) against GST-tagged full-length IRAK4. A DC50 is a degradation potency, not an affinity: quoting 0.46 nM would overstate the chemistry by 1.95 logs. Degrader precedent IS small-molecule precedent and it is counted as such; what it is NOT is evidence that any particular site is bindable.

4/5. Is the structural evidence an artifact of one crystal form or one additive? The 6EGE ligand DL1 is a 379 Da N-aryl pyridine-carboxamide with a morpholine and a pyrazole — ordinary med-chem, not a detergent (contrast CD20's Y01 cholesteryl hemisuccinate and RORgt 6C1P's CHAPSO), not a bis-electrophile (contrast 2AZ5's compound 307). It is one of 92 holo entries on this accession, so the site is not a single-crystal-form artifact. No frequent-hitter or aggregator database was queried, so is_known_frequent_hitter stays null rather than being asserted false. PARTIALLY RUN.

10/11. Is a perfect-looking result the absence of a counterexample? Watched for, and one was actively avoided: 5UIQ is titled 'Crystal structure of IRAK4 in complex with compound 9' and would read as a ninety-third holo entry, but its only heteroatom group is 8BV, 2-[(propan-2-yl)oxy]benzamide, 179.2 Da and 13 heavy atoms — a fragment. NEW — is a 'death-domain-containing' structure actually modelling the death domain? pdb_v.uniprot_alignment_ranges says TWO Q9NWZ3 entries span the death domain: 3MOP (min_uniprot_pos 4, max 106, residues_resolved 103) and 8DKS (min 1, max 460, residues_resolved 460). 8DKS would have entered a death-domain ensemble on that evidence. It must not: reading 8DKS.cif directly, its modelled auth_seq range is 164-459 — kinase domain only, 4,410 atoms, and its ligand SO9 (474.6 Da) sits in the ATP site. FOUND: 3MOP is the ONLY PDB entry that models the IRAK4 death domain, and it took a coordinate-level check to establish it.

3. Do the actives collapse to one series or one lab? Not resolvable to chemotype in this run, but bounded from above: 11,416 distinct compounds across 32,838 activities and five unrelated assay formats (AlphaScreen biochemical, monocyte TNF cell-based, U-937 inhibition, kinase activity, DELFIA enzymatic) each contributing 5-10%. A single-series artifact cannot produce that assay spread. The `GROUP BY assay_id` that would settle chemotype provenance is the query the statement timeout blocks. PARTIALLY RUN.

5a. Does the pocket appear in one crystal form only? No: the ATP-site pocket was located in 6 of 6 measurements — three entries (one holo, two apo, three separate depositions in 2007, 2007 and 2019) at two clustering values.

7. What was tried in the clinic and why did it stop? NOT RUN — see not_found. terminated_programs is [] because no termination search was performed, NOT because none exists. Rule 7 and the falsification skill both warn that absence of terminated programs must never be read as a good sign, and an empty list produced without a search is exactly that error waiting to happen.
